dct_description_sm: Salinity and temperature in sea ice influence the ice algae habitat, and also permit to determine the percentage and salinity of brines in sea ice during the season. Due to the importance of ice algae, which represent the second source of primary production (up to 57%) in the ice-covered central Arctic (Gosselin et al., 1997; Arrigo et al., 2010), it is essential to characterize their environment and the advancement of the melting period. It becomes essential to monitor these physical data, complementary of chemical and biological data.
dct_title_s: Sea ice salinity and temperature at Qikiqtarjuak, Nunavut
